headline: Energy, Confcommercio alarm: "In Italy electricity up to 70 euros/MWh more expensive"
summary: Confcommercio and energy stakeholders say Italy pays far more for electricity than major European countries. They warn a new shock on international energy markets risks widening the gap.
why: Electricity prices affect industrial margins, consumer inflation and competitiveness, and Italy's power market is closely linked to gas prices.
